sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: five separately painted animation cutouts for a cozy watercolor travel puzzle. Transparent RGBA sprite atlas, landscape1536x1024, precisely three columns and two rows with generous empty transparent margins and gutters, bottom right cell entirely blank. Every complete subject contained within its own cell, no crossing rows or columns, maximum subject height400px. TRUE transparent alpha, NO backdrop, blurred color halo, rectangle, grid, checkerboard, lettering, stickers or outlines. Hand-painted gouache/watercolor paper pigment texture ON SUBJECTS ONLY, subtle painterly brush strokes, gentle light upperleft, natural warm colors, softlypainted edges. Five isolated subjects: For terracotta music courtyard. Top left: small cream and terracotta triangular pennant hanging from a tiny TOP CENTER loop. Top middle: small ochre paper lantern with thin hanging TOP CENTER loop, matte watercolor, not luminous. Top right: thin cream ribbon tied at top with two tails hanging down. Bottom left: SHORT curved cream-white flower garland with two visible cord attachment endpoints at upperleft and upperright, light narrow floral string, no massive bouquet. Bottom middle: narrow sage cloth streamer tied to a tiny top loop. No wall or peg.
